description.text: Pregunta 01What characteristic describes spyware?

answers.text: the use of stolen credentials to access private data
an attack that slows or crashes a device or network service
a network device that filters access and traffic coming into a network
software that is installed on a user device and collects information about the user

description.text: Pregunta 02Which statement describes network security?

answers.text: It ensures sensitive corporate data is available for authorized users.
It supports growth over time in accordance with approved network design procedures.
It prioritizes data flows in order to give priority to delay-sensitive traffic.
It synchronizes traffic flows using timestamps.

description.text: Pregunta 04What is a user trying to determine when issuing a ping 10.1.1.1 command on a PC?

answers.text: if the TCP/IP stack is functioning on the PC without putting traffic on the wire
if there is connectivity with the destination device
what type of device is at the destination
the path that traffic will take to reach the destination

answers.text: An SVI is created in software and requires a configured IP address and a subnet mask in order to provide remote access to the switch.

Although it is a virtual interface, it needs to have physical hardware on the device associated with it.
SVIs do not require the no shutdown command to become enabled.

description.text: Pregunta 15Although CSMA/CD is still a feature of Ethernet, why is it no longer necessary?

the use of CSMA/CA

the use of Gigabit Ethernet speeds

answers.text: forwards the new frame appropriate to the medium of that segment of the physical network

description.text: Pregunta 19If the default gateway is configured incorrectly on the host, what is the impact on communications?

answers.text: The host can communicate with other hosts on the local network, but is unable to communicate with hosts on remote networks.
There is no impact on communications.
The host is unable to communicate on the local network.
The host can communicate with other hosts on remote networks, but is unable to communicate with hosts on the local network.

description.text: Pregunta 20Why is NAT not needed in IPv6?

answers.text: Any host or user can get a public IPv6 network address because the number of available IPv6 addresses is extremely large.
Because IPv6 has integrated security, there is no need to hide the IPv6 addresses of internal networks.
The end-to-end connectivity problems that are caused by NAT are solved because the number of routes increases with the number of nodes that are connected to the Internet.
The problems that are induced by NAT applications are solved because the IPv6 header improves packet handling by intermediate routers.
